reason: to spread / to extend is exactly the sense used by 海が広がる; dictionaries group spread, extend and stretch out as one sense.
The sun setting is the ordinary sink / go down sense; currentEN 'to go under' and currentZH 降下 both read correctly against 太陽が沈む.
'to stop or refrain from doing' restates 'to cease' / 停止; 止す has only this one sense.
'to be filled with' is 'to be full' / 充满 with the に-phrase spelled out; same sense.
Distinct dictionary sense (supply exhausted / expires). Neither 'to break, to snap' nor 断/切断 lets a learner read 電池が切れる as the battery running out.
'to knock down or cause to fall' is 'to throw down' / 弄倒; the wind-vs-person agent is a sentence detail, not a sense split.
Threading is the same causing-passage-through meaning as 'to let pass' / 让通过; a learner maps 糸を通す onto it without a new gloss.
'with a sweet smile' is the adverbial rewording of the existing 'smile sweetly' / 微微一笑.
The する-verb use of the same noun sense 'engagement' / 订婚; a part-of-speech variant, not an added meaning.
'manufacturing of goods' restates 'manufacture, production' / 制造.
台風が去る is the plain 'to leave, to go away' / 离去 sense; the '(of weather)' qualifier comes from the sentence's subject.
'to save a life' is 'to rescue from' / 拯救 with the sentence's object 命 attached; the meaning itself is unchanged.
Describes what the sentence is about (a bicycle) rather than any sense of 修理; the word is just 'repairing' / 修理.
'border between countries' is a definition of the existing 'national border' / 国境.
'circle formed by people' is the sentence's referent; the word sense is the already-listed ring / circle, 环, 圈.
'other people' is literally the existing gloss 'others' / 他人.

Separate dictionary sense (abstract facet of a matter), distinct from face / mask / physical surface; a learner given 'face, mask, surface' cannot read 肯定的な面 as a positive aspect. Note the ZH list already carries 方面, so dedupe on merge.
'share or portion' is the existing 'part' / 份 sense; dictionaries list part, share and portion together.
悩んだ末に reads directly off 'the end of' / 末尾 ('at the end of deliberating'); the ～た末に pattern is grammar, not an extra lexical sense.
'diagram or illustration' is covered by 'figure, drawing' / 图, 图表.
Separate dictionary sense; 'needle, pin' gives a learner nothing for 時計の針. The ZH list already has 指针, so dedupe on merge.
Gristle, tendon and sinew sit in the same dictionary sense as 'muscle', and 筋 is already in the ZH list.
'apology / I am sorry' restates 'I beg your pardon, excuse me' / 对不起, 抱歉.
Visiting the sick is the same dictionary sense as 'enquiry, expression of sympathy', and 探望 in the ZH list is exactly 'to visit someone ill'.
Separate dictionary sense; 'unit, denomination' does not let a learner read 大学で単位を取る as earning course credits. The ZH list already has 学分, so dedupe on merge.
'to sell in large quantities' is the existing 'to sell well' / 畅销.
'female parent' is a definition of 'mother' / 母亲.
'sudden violent bursting' is a definition of 'explosion' / 爆炸.
'seven day period' is a definition of 'week' / 周, 星期.
'bound away from the hub' is precisely the existing 'down-train' / 下行 sense.
'mechanical device or system' restates 'equipment, installation' / 装置, 设备.
